Atlas Hold.name: Atlas Hold
Atlas Hold.description: The user lays both hands on a collapsing building, a falling bridge span or a derailed train and takes the weight out of the whole thing at once. For the rest of the scene nothing in it falls: walls, rubble, vehicles and the people inside hang where they are and can be floated out by hand, but if the user is knocked out, everything still inside comes down. Strain: severe.
